note: Curated from community BSOD threads, vendor advisories, and storage forums. 'level' applies to Native NVMe (nvmedisk.sys) operation. Patterns: controller substring (case-insensitive), firmware exact (case-insensitive) or '*' wildcard. Prefix with '=' for exact controller match. Unknown entries are treated as 'proceed with caution' in the UI.

entries.note: Samsung's current 990 PRO firmware (December 2025, read stability). No native NVMe problems reported. Samsung Magician can't see the drive while nvmedisk.sys is active, so do firmware updates before enabling.

Samsung's September 2025 firmware fixes intermittent non-recognition and blue screens. The earlier random-write slowdown report on this firmware was retracted by its author (SLC cache exhaustion, not firmware).

Firmware older than 7B2QJXD7 can drop off or blue-screen; Samsung fixed that in 7B2QJXD7 (September 2025). Update in Samsung Magician first, since Magician can't see the drive while nvmedisk.sys is active.
Samsung's current 980 PRO firmware. No native NVMe problems reported. Samsung Magician can't see the drive while nvmedisk.sys is active, so do firmware updates before enabling.
Update to 5B2QGXA7, Samsung's current 980 PRO firmware, in Samsung Magician before enabling Native NVMe. Magician can't see the drive while nvmedisk.sys is active.
Community reports tie SN850X to Critical Failure / boot-loop behavior under nvmedisk.sys. Keep this model on stornvme.sys unless you have local recovery coverage and a known-good firmware result.

Crucial P3. An early forum report of paging errors under sustained 4K random writes couldn't be re-confirmed in its source. Benchmark with the watchdog active.
Mixed community benchmark result: stable reports exist, but gains are negligible on some P41 systems. Benchmark before/after and keep rollback ready.
Phison E18-based drive. The caution follows the Phison E18 power-loss reports rather than reports about this model. Use UPS/power protection and keep backups current.

Intel 670p / 665p. An earlier hang report couldn't be re-confirmed in its source and no other reports were found. Update Intel/Solidigm firmware and make sure the drive isn't behind RST/VMD before enabling.
Phison-based Rocket models need current firmware plus power-loss protection; community reports warn about RAW partition corruption risk during writes under nvmedisk.sys.
Early Phison E18 firmware string from a forum report that couldn't be re-confirmed. The Phison E18 power-loss caution still applies; update the drive firmware first.
Community reports warn Phison E18 platforms can expose RAW partition corruption after power loss while writes are in flight under nvmedisk.sys. Use UPS/power protection and keep backups current.

cveAdvisories.description: Kernel RCE in Windows Server 2025 NVMe-oF (NVMe over Fabrics). It doesn't affect local nvmedisk.sys on Windows 11 client. It's listed so Server 2025 operators of this tool who also use NVMe-oF patch promptly, and so client users don't panic over the headline.
